metadata.name: CORE — Visual and interaction contracts
metadata.usage: Load when defining a frontend identity or implementing an interface. Do not impose a full design system on a task with no UI.

obligatorio_si_hay_interfaz.regla: Keep the stack, components, and identity already present in the repository.
WCAG 2.2 level AA is the default target, unless the user sets another level.
Text and components do not communicate state by color alone.
Keyboard, visible focus, an accessible name, and error messages tied to the field.
Do not use emoji as interface icons. Use the project's icon set or, if none exists, one family (Lucide or Material Symbols).

identidad.regla: An identifiable icon in vector form when the project creates a brand. Readable at a small size.
The project name sits with the brand in the header, and global search only when the product needs it.
One convention for icon size, stroke, and states.

navegacion.regla: Header, sidebar, footer, and mobile access are designed for the product. A legal footer is not required on every authenticated view.
The active state is visible and items are grouped by area. Do not duplicate the same action in two places.

notificaciones.regla: Transient messages may dismiss themselves. Critical errors, pending decisions, and required actions stay until the user resolves them.
They can be dismissed by hand. If there is a timer, pause it on interaction when the implementation allows it.
A live region for screen readers. Do not repeat the same notice.
Do not cover the primary action or the field that caused the error.

estados_cuando_apliquen.estado: Validation and a single form submission.
Insufficient permission and an expired session.
Confirmation proportional to the risk of a destructive action.

prompt.hipotesis: Hick's law, Fitts's law, Jakob's law, Prägnanz, proximity, Tesler's law, Doherty's threshold, the von Restorff effect, and recognition over recall are design hypotheses. Apply one when it helps the task, and set it aside with a reason when the context asks for that. They are not a quota of elements and not an obligation to copy a sample dashboard.
